breaks: /api/chat returns 400 (was 500) for image generation models instead of loading and failing.
/api/chat and /api/generate return 400 (was 500) for embedding and reranking models instead of loading and failing.
break_rulings.why: Clients that match on 500 error responses will no longer catch these errors and may misinterpret the result.
Alias resolution on /api/show is additive (404→200); refusal of aliases on pull/delete is a bug fix, not a break for working setups.

breaks: TheNoise shared backend is updated from v0.12.1 to v0.15.0, which may change inference behavior or memory layout for existing models.
break_rulings.why: Users upgrading silently get the new backend, and existing image generation setups may produce different output or fail to load.

breaks: GET /pull/variants returns 400 (was 500) for repositories without supported model files.
break_rulings.why: Clients that matched on 500 for this case will no longer catch it.
The embeddings path was returning 400 and is now fixed to return vectors; no working setup is broken by the repair.

evidence.blockers: The TheNoise 0.15.0 upgrade must be verified against existing models (0c2aa03-4, P0) before shipping — a major backend version jump with no end-to-end inference evidence. The Windows AMD iGPU memory fix (57773fe) needs real hardware validation or context sizing remains broken. The FLM backend install and embeddings path (e452c7e) need NPU hardware verification. The /pull/variants 400 change (4d0568a) affects clients matching on 500.
evidence.breaking_changes: Three breaking changes ship: (1) /api/chat and /api/generate return 400 instead of 500 for non-LLM models — clients matching on 500 must update. (2) TheNoise backend is upgraded from 0.12.1 to 0.15.0 — existing models may behave differently under the new binary. (3) GET /pull/variants returns 400 instead of 500 for unsupported repositories — clients matching on 500 must update. Two reported changes (alias resolution on /api/show, embeddings path repair) are behavioral improvements, not breaks.
evidence.coverage: All 20 commits in the range are reviewed. The 20 digest entries cover 32 to-dos across Ollama gateway behavior (rejection, alias resolution, streaming errors, audio/image input, capability reporting), custom image model registration in the GUI, TheNoise backend upgrade, FLM backend upgrade, Windows AMD iGPU memory detection, /pull/variants error code, docs-only CI gating, WebSocket auth, backend version bumps, and maintainer tooling.
evidence.manual_testing: New backends (TheNoise 0.15.0, FLM 1.0.13) need end-to-end inference on real hardware. New GUI model registration flow needs the custom model editor exercised with actual checkpoints. New Ollama behaviors (image model rejection, alias resolution, audio input, decision model, speech model) need manual endpoint testing. Windows AMD iGPU memory reporting requires a Ryzen AI system. The docs-only CI fast path needs a live docs-only PR to verify the matrix-name-expansion edge case is resolved.
evidence.security: WebSocket authentication fix (b1e53c4) removes API key leakage from URL query strings — a security improvement. FLM 1.0.13 ships AMD-signed Windows binaries instead of unsigned builds. No new supply-chain or credential concerns observed in the release range.
